evidence: the-full-update-script-leaves-nothing-to-update: yum-update-dist.sh (sha256 70fdcab7...) is the single line '/usr/bin/yum update -y' and manifest 17-24 installs it as the 'full updates' script; the action runs it as installed and keeps only its exit code, while the read-only effect queries 'dnf -q check-update' itself (rc 0 = nothing pending), so the evidence is the node's update state, not the action's output; mutates declares the full yum update and the /run/p8test-yum/dist.txt file

update-scripts-installed: manifest 18-24 (and 9-15) declare the files in ${localdir}/bin mode 0755 owner root from the module's yum/ sources; with the lab Hiera localdir /opt/puppet-infrastructure the probe's stat (root 755) and sha256 against the baseline files' hashes (bd37299a..., 70fdcab7..., the same as the sha256 references) test exactly that; group root is not probed, which narrows but does not contradict the lines

the-surface-script-brings-the-exposed-packages-up-to-date: manifest line 8 '# security surface updates' labels yum-update-surface.sh, which loops 'yum update -y' over SURFACE='openssh-server openssh nginx openssl ca-certificates httpd', prints 'error updating package

' on a non-zero yum rc and always exits 0; the effect checks rc=0, that every error line names a package rpm -q reports not installed, and runs 'dnf check-update' itself on the installed surface packages (pending rc 0); the runner runs action+effect per check in file order, so this effect is observed before the dist script's full update can mask it; mutates matches the script's SURFACE list

purpose covered: Purpose (yum update helpers for RedHat-family servers: a per-package surface update script and a full update script) matches the baseline header 'helper scripts for yum based system updates' and the two file resources. The checks test that both scripts are installed byte-identical, root-owned and executable, and that running each as an operator does its job on the registered rhel9 node: the installed surface packages and then all packages have no update pending afterwards. Untested: the surface script's output filtering (grep Updating | cut), which is cosmetic, and nginx/httpd being updated, which is not possible because the rhel9 node does not install them (the error-line rule allows only that case). The set has no uncovered notes, and none of these gaps is a part of the purpose that the lab can exercise and that is left untested.
